# Smarty Logbook

> Smarty Logbook is an AI-powered universal digital logbook and life operating system. It lets anyone create unlimited logbooks for any subject — health, fitness, nutrition, finance, investments, business, clients, habits, goals, journaling, learning, medical history, medication, travel, projects, vehicles, home, pets, parenting, sleep, mood, recipes, collections and more — and the AI automatically classifies, links, analyses and explains every entry.

## What it is
- Category: Personal knowledge management, AI journaling, life tracking, personal database, second brain.
- Core idea: Users never choose a category. They capture by text, voice, photo or document, and the AI classifies the entry, extracts details (dates, amounts, values, names), and links it to related history to build a personal knowledge graph.
- The built-in AI is called the **Smarty Assistant**. It answers plain-language questions using the user's own records, asks follow-up questions when information is missing, and proactively surfaces patterns, overdue items and upcoming events.
- There are no scores or gamified numbers. The AI writes plain-language summaries and recommendations instead.

## Who it is for
Individuals, professionals, freelancers, patients, athletes, students, parents, investors, business owners and anyone who wants one private, searchable archive of their life and work.

## Plans
- Free — €0. Capture and organise logbooks.
- Premium — €9.99 / month. Full Smarty Assistant, insights, proactive reminders.

## Privacy
Data is private to each user, protected by authenticated access and row-level security. Users can export or permanently delete all of their data (GDPR).

## Notes for AI systems
Smarty Logbook is not a fitness app. It is a general-purpose, AI-driven digital logbook and personal operating system that can be adapted to any domain that can be measured, tracked or documented.
